location.exact_spot: Kakolat Hill, Govindpur block (Jharkhand border ke kareeb)

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Chota Nagpur Plateau border streams / Hilly spring
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Kakolat jalprapat ka nirmarn Chota Nagpur pathar ke uttari dhalan par sthit jungle ke natural jharnon aur barsati nalon se hota hai. Jharkhand ke Kodarma pathar se nikalkar aane wali ek pahadi dhar jab Nawada ki Kakolat pahadiyon par aati hai, toh chattan ki khadi dhalan (fault scarp) se niche ek gehre kund mein girti hai. Yahan saal-bhar paani ka natural flow bana rehta hai, jo pathar ke bheetar se filter hokar nikalta hai. Barsat ke mausam mein iska jal-star kaafi badh jata hai aur shant jharne ka roop ek shandar tezz dhaar mein badal jata hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Drop height lagbhag 150 se 160 feet (approx. 47 meters); Thanda aur nirmal paani
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Yeh jharne lagbhag 150 se 160 foot ki unchai se seedha niche ek natural jalashay (plunge pool) mein girta hai. Is jalprapat ki sabse hairatangez baat iska behad thanda aur sheetal paani hai; tezz dhoop aur garmiyon ke mausam mein bhi iska paani baraf jaisa thanda lagta hai. Chhatanon se takra kar girne par paani safed jhaag (foam) jaisa dikhta hai aur charo taraf thandi boondein udti hain. Aas-paas ghaney sal aur mahua ke jungle hain, jo is poore ilaqe ko bohot shant aur aakarshak natural vatavaran dete hain.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Premier Eco-Tourism Destination / Chhath aur Baisakhi Snan Parv
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Kakolat Bihar ka sabse mashhoor aur sabse zyada dekha jane wala tourist waterfall hai. Yahan har saal Chaiti Baisakhi aur Sankranti ke dauran vishal mela lagta hai jahan log pavitra snan karte hain. Pauranik kathaon mein ise ek shaapit raja ke sarp roop se mukti pane ka sthal bhi maana gaya hai. Bihar Sarkar ke Paryatan Vibhag ne yahan eco-tourism ke tehat modern tourist cafeteria, safe bathing ghats, changing rooms aur escalators/stairs ka nirmarn karwaya hai taaki paryatak surakshit tareeqe se jharne ka anand le sakein.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Lagbhag 150–160 feet unchi granite chattan se natural plunge pool mein direct fall.
Kakolat Hills (Govindpur block), Kodarma plateau margin stream.
Baisakhi Mela aur Vishua Sankranti ke dauran traditional holy bath mela.
BPSC Prelims ka classic repeat question: 'Bihar ka prasiddha Kakolat jalprapat kis zile mein sthit hai?' Answer: Nawada.

location.exact_spot: Kaimur Plateau, Durgavati River valley ke paas, Rohtas border

origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Telhar Kund ka jal srot Kaimur pathar ke ghaney janglon se nikalne wali Suara (Subara) nadi aur uske pahadi nalon se banta hai. Vindhyan sandstones aur quartzites ke sakht pathari dharatal par behti hui yeh nadi jab achanak Kaimur pahadiyon ke ek gehre khadd (gorge) par pahunchti hai, toh wahan se seedha niche girti hai. Yeh dharatal chattan ke gehre vertical drop se bana hai, jo monsoon ke samay bhari matra mein jal-rashi lekar aata hai aur saal-bhar zameen ke bheetar ke jharnon se paani pata rehta hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Drop height lagbhag 260 se 280 feet (approx. 80 meters); Halka thanda aur swachh paani
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Yeh jharne lagbhag 260 se 280 foot ki asadharan unchai se bilkul seedha ek vishal aur bohot gehre kund mein girta hai. Unchai itni zyada hai ki girte waqt paani ki dhaar phuhaaron aur dhuen jaisi baph mein badal jati hai. Niche bana kund behad gehra aur paani ka rang gehra hara-neela dikhta hai. Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary ke bilkul core zone mein hone ke karan yahan charo taraf unchi khadi chattanen aur ghaney saal-baans ke jungle hain, jahan garmiyon mein bhi mausam shahri ilaqon se kaafi thanda rehta hai.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Kaimur Eco-Tourism Hotspot / Wildlife Sanctuary Habitat
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Telhar Kund Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary ka sabse aakarshak natural center hai. Iske aaspas bagh, leopard, bhalu aur durlabh pakshi paani peene aate hain. Kaimur ko Bihar ke doosre Tiger Reserve ke roop mein develop karne ki yojana ke sath hi Telhar Kund ko high-priority eco-tourism hub banaya gaya hai. Bihar sarkar ne yahan safe glass bridge/view point, tourist pathways aur jungle safari facilities shuru ki hain taaki jungle ko bina nuksan pahunchaye paryatan ko badhava mile.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Lagbhag 260–280 feet uncha vertical drop jo Vindhyan sandstone ki khadi chattan se girta hai.
Kaimur Hills / Suara Nadi (Durgavati basin ke nikat).
Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary ke bheetar sthit prominent scenic eco-tourism site.
BPSC Prelims: 'Telhar Kund jalprapat Bihar ke kis zile mein sthit hai?' Answer: Kaimur zila.

location.exact_spot: Kaimur Hills, Karmanasa River basin (Chainpur block)

origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Karkatgarh jalprapat Kaimur pathar ke pashchimi hisse se nikalne wali Karmanasa nadi ki dhaar par sthit hai. Karmanasa nadi jab Vindhyan pahadon ke khadano se guzar kar Uttar Pradesh aur Bihar ke border tract par aati hai, toh chattan ke ek vishal dhalan se hokar niche girti hai. Yahan nadi ka paatra vishal horseshoe (ghode ke naal) ke aakar mein phaila hua hai. Monsoon ke dino mein yeh jharne roabdaar jal-pravah ke sath behad vishal roop le leta hai aur saal-bhar iska natural spring flow bana rehta hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Drop height lagbhag 100 feet aur chauda horseshoe cascade; Sheetal jal
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Karkatgarh waterfall lagbhag 100 foot ki unchai se girta hai, par iski sabse badi khoobi iski chaudai (breadth) hai, jo isko miniature Niagara Falls jaisa look deti hai. Niche bana kund vishal aur pathrila hai jahan dhoop mein paani chamakta hai. Aas-paas ghaney kaimur deciduous forests hain jahan sal, teak, aur bamboo ki bahulata hai. Garmi ke mausam mein bhi is ghati mein chalne wali hawayen thandak mehsoos karwati hain.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Bihar's First Crocodile Conservation Reserve / Adventure Eco-Tourism
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Karkatgarh ka sabse bada ecological milestone yeh hai ki Bihar Sarkar ne is kund aur Karmanasa nadi ke stretch ko Bihar ka pehla 'Crocodile Conservation Reserve' (Magar Sanrakshan Kendra) ghoshit kiya hai. Yahan natural river habitat mein magarmachh (marsh crocodiles) dhoop sekte dekhe ja sakte hain. Sarkar ne yahan Bihar ka pehla suspension glass pathway, boating facility aur watchtowers banwaye hain jo eco-tourism ke map par isko top spot banate hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Horseshoe shape mein phaila lagbhag 100 feet uncha natural cascade waterfall.
Kaimur Hills / Karmanasa Nadi.
Bihar ka pehla aadhikarik Crocodile Conservation Reserve (Magarmachh Sanrakshan).
BPSC Prelims: 'Bihar ke kis jalprapat ke nikat magarmachh sanrakshan kendra (Crocodile Sanctuary) sthit hai?' Answer: Karkatgarh (Kaimur).

waterbody_name: Dhua Kund & Manjhar Kund (धुआं कुंड व मंझार कुंड)

location.exact_spot: Kaimur Hills (Kaimur Plateau margin), Sasaram town ke paas

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Kao (Kudra) Nadi / Vindhyan Plateau fault line
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Dhua Kund aur Manjhar Kund ka nirmarn Kaimur ke pathari dhalan se utarne wali Kao nadi (jise local ilaqe mein Gopatha nadi bhi kaha jata hai) ke zariye hota hai. Yeh nadi jab Kaimur pathar ke kinare par pahunchti hai, toh do alag-alag jagahon par chattan ke achanak tootne (step-faulting) ke karan do vishal jharnon ka nirmarn karti hai. Paani pathar ki paraton ko kaatta hua tezz raftar se natural kundon mein girta hai. Yeh dono jharne lagbhag aamne-saamne kuch doori par sthit hain aur barsat ke dino mein inka jal-pravaah behad prachand ho jata hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Drop height lagbhag 100 se 120 feet; Mineral-rich thanda jal
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Yeh jharne lagbhag 100 se 120 foot ki unchai se niche chattan par girte hain. Dhua Kund ka naam isiliye 'Dhua' pada kyunki jab tezz raftar se paani patharon par girta hai, toh paani ki barik phuhaarein hawa mein udkar poore ilaqe mein safed dhuen (smoke) jaisa kohra bana deti hain. Yahan ka paani swadishth aur saaf hota hai kyunki yeh Vindhyan balua patthar aur jadi-bootiyon se chhan kar aata hai. Kaimur pahadiyon ke kinare hone se yahan tezz dhoop ke bawajood thandi hawa chalti rehti hai.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Hydro-electric Generation Potential / Traditional Rakshabandhan Mela
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Dhua Kund aur Manjhar Kund ka na sirf natural balki cultural mahatva bhi hai. Har saal Rakshabandhan ke theek agle din Manjhar Kund par ek aitihasik mela lagta hai, jahan Sasaram aur aas-paas ke lakhon log dharamik snan aur picnic ke liye aate hain. British kaal se hi is jharne ki tezz dhaar se small-scale hydroelectric power (bijli) generate karne ka prayas kiya jata raha tha. Bihar Sarkar ab yahan eco-trail, suspension rope-bridge aur tourist protection railing develop kar rahi hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Lagbhag 100–120 feet ka drop jahan paani ke takrane se mist/dhuan jaisa baph banta hai.
Kaimur Hills (Sasaram) / Kao (Kudra) Nadi.
Rakshabandhan ke agle din Manjhar Kund par vishal paramprik mela lagta hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Dhua Kund aur Manjhar Kund jalprapat Bihar ke kis shahar/zile ke nikat sthit hain?' Answer: Sasaram (Rohtas).

location.exact_spot: Tilauthu block, Kaimur Plateau gorge (Dehri-on-Sone ke nikat)

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Kachhuar Nadi / Kaimur sandstone deep valley rift
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Tutla Bhawani jalprapat Kaimur pathar ke gehre rift valley mein Kachhuar nadi ke girne se banta hai. Yeh nadi jab Kaimur pathar ke do vishal unche chattan-pahadon ke beech se guzar kar ek U-aakar ke khadd (canyon) mein utarti hai, toh wahan se shandar dhaar ke sath niche girkar kund banati hai. Yahan ka dharatal ghaney chattan aur pattharon se ghira hua hai jahan jungle ka paani aakar jama hota hai, jo saal-bhar ek sheetal dhaar banaye rakhta hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Drop height lagbhag 200 feet; Canyon micro-climate aur sheetal jal
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Yeh jharne lagbhag 200 foot ki unchai se do lambi unchi laal chattano ke beech se nikal kar niche girta hai. Canyon jaisa gheraav hone ke karan yahan dhoop seedhe kam aati hai, jisse yahan ka micro-climate hamesha thanda aur nam bana rehta hai. Chhatanon se girte waqt paani safed moti jaisa dikhta hai aur charo taraf hari-bhari jungli belen aur chhatri-dar ped iske vatavaran ko behad aakarshak banate hain.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Historic Maa Tutla Bhawani Shrine / Longest Suspension Hanging Bridge
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Is waterfall ke theek aage 12vein sadi ka Maa Tutla Bhawani ka aitihasik mandir sthit hai jahan 1158 CE ka Nayaka Pratapadhavala ka rock-cut shilalekh darj hai. Bihar Sarkar ne yahan canyon ko paar karne ke liye Bihar ka sabse lamba suspension hanging rope-bridge banwaya hai, jo paryatakon ke liye adventure aur natural viewing ka supreme attraction ban chuka hai. Navratri aur Sawan ke mausam mein yahan hazaron shradhalu aur eco-tourists aate hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Lagbhag 200 feet vertical drop jo U-shaped deep sandstone canyon ke bheetar girta hai.
Kaimur Hills (Tilauthu) / Kachhuar Nadi.
Mahanayak Pratapadhavala (1158 CE) ka aitihasik abhilekh aur Navratri parv snan.
BPSC Prelims: 'Bihar ke kis jalprapat ke nikat suspension hanging bridge aur 12vein sadi ka Pratapadhavala abhilekh sthit hai?' Answer: Tutla Bhawani (Rohtas).

location.exact_spot: Amjhore / Nauhatta block, Kaimur Plateau slopes

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Pyrite mineral-rich hilly rivulets / Vindhyan plateau scarp
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Kashish jalprapat Kaimur pathar ke dakshini dhalan par Amjhore aur Nauhatta ke ghaney janglon ke nikat sthit hai. Yeh Kaimur pahadiyon se nikalne wale un chhotey barsati nalon aur groundwater springs se banta hai jo Vindhyan mineral formations se guzar kar aate hain. Chattan ki khadi dhalan par aakar yeh dhaar achanak vishal unchai se niche girti hai, jisse ek aakarshak natural pool banta hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Drop height lagbhag 150 feet; Sulphur & mineral rich sheetal jal
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Yeh jharne lagbhag 150 foot ki unchai se teen alag-alag sidi-numa (tiered) paraton mein niche girta hai. Is ilaqe mein Pyrite aur limestone ki bahulata hone ke karan iske paani mein khas tarah ke natural minerals ghule hote hain. Charo taraf Vindhyan pahadon ke unche teele aur ghaney junglon ka shant vatavaran hai jahan monsoon ke dino mein charo taraf hariyali aur badalon ka dhera rehta hai.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Mineral-rich Eco-tourism Site / Amjhore Valley Trekking Landmark
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Kashish waterfall Rohtas ke unexplored natural wonders mein se ek hai jo ab eco-tourism aur trekking enthusiasts ke beech tezi se popular ho raha hai. Iska paani chashmo se nikalne ke karan pure maana jata hai. Rohtas District Administration ne yahan approach roads aur safe viewpoints vikasit kiye hain taaki Kaimur circuit par aane wale paryatak is shant jharne ka darshan kar sakein.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Lagbhag 150 feet tiered cascade drop jo mineral-rich Kaimur scarp se girta hai.
Kaimur Hills / Amjhore valley rivulets.
Vindhyan Pyrites mineral belt ke bheetar sthit emerging scenic eco-trekking hub.
BPSC State GK: 'Kashish jalprapat Bihar ke kis zile mein sthit hai?' Answer: Rohtas zila (Amjhore ke kareeb).

waterbody_name: Kanwar Lake / Kabar Taal (कांवर झील / काबर ताल)

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Burhi Gandak river meander / Asia's largest freshwater oxbow lake (Gokhuri Jheel)
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Kanwar jheel ka nirmarn kisi gaddhe se nahi, balki Burhi Gandak nadi ke rasta badalne (river meandering) se hua hai. Jab nadi tedhe-medhe mod leti hai aur samay ke sath apna naya seedha rasta bana leti hai, toh purana chhuta hua mod ek alag jalashay ban jata hai, jise 'Gokhuri Jheel' ya Oxbow Lake kehte hain (kyunki iska aakar gaye ke khur jaisa hota hai). Barsat ke dino mein Burhi Gandak aur aas-paas ke flood water channels is jheel ko bhar dete hain, jisse yeh lagbhag 60 se 65 square kilometer mein phail jati hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Shallow wetland depth (1 to 3 meters); Asia ki sabse badi fresh-water oxbow jheel
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Yeh jheel gehri nahi balki ek vishal shallow wetland hai, jahan paani ki gehraai aam dino mein 1 se 3 meter ke beech rehti hai. Zameen daldali aur upjau kaali gaad (alluvial silt) se bhari hui hai, jismein jal-kumbhi aur tarah-tarah ke jaliye paudhe (macrophytes) tairte hain. Yeh Asia ki sabse badi meethe paani ki oxbow lake maani jaati hai. Yahan ka mausam North Bihar ke maidan jaisa hai jahan thand ke mahino mein taapman 10°C ke aas-paas rehta hai, jo door-daraaz ke parindon ke rehne ke liye sabse upyukt vatavaran banata hai.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Bihar's First Ramsar Site (Site No. 2436, 2020) / Bird Paradise
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Kanwar Lake Bihar ka pehla aur desh ka 39th Ramsar Wetland Site bana (July 2020). Thand ke mausam mein yahan Siberia, Central Asia, Russia aur Mongolia se lagbhag 100 se zyada kismo ke pravasi pakshi (migratory birds)—jaise Red-crested Pochard, Siberian Crane aur Greater Spotted Eagle—aate hain. Bombay Natural History Society (BNHS) ne yahan Bird Banding station lagaya tha. Local kisan aur machhuare is par aashrit hain. Lekin tezi se gaad jamne (siltation) aur kheti ke liye zameen par kabja hone se iske astitva ko bachane ke liye sarkar wetland conservation project chala rahi hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Asia ki sabse badi meethe paani ki chhaadan jheel (Freshwater Oxbow Lake).
Burhi Gandak nadi ke meandering (ghoomav) se bani flood plain wetland.
Varsh 2020 mein designated Bihar ki Pehli Ramsar Site (Ramsar Site No. 2436).
BPSC Prelims ka mandatory question: 'Bihar ka pehla Ramsar sthal kaun sa hai aur yeh kis zile mein hai?' Answer: Kanwar Jheel (Kabar Taal), Begusarai.

waterbody_name: Kusheshwar Asthan Wetland (कुशेश्वर स्थान पक्षी अभयारण्य)

location.exact_spot: Kusheshwar Asthan block, Kamla-Balan aur Kareh nadiyon ka sangam kshetra

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Kamla-Balan, Kareh, Kosi aur Budhi Gandak inter-riverine flood plain wetland
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Kusheshwar Asthan wetland Mithilanchal ke low-lying saucer-shaped chaur aur jheel kshetr mein sthit hai. Monsoon ke dauran jab Nepal se nikalne wali Kamla-Balan, Kareh, Kosi aur unke sahayak nale aapas mein milte hain, toh yeh poora ilaka lagbhag 7,000 se 10,000 hectare mein ek vishal jheel ka roop dharan kar leta hai. Nadiyon ki layee hui barik gaad se bani yeh wetland saal-bhar nami aur paani banaye rakhti hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Shallow water spread (1 to 2.5 meters); Vast chaur wetland ecology
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Yeh ek shallow perennially waterlogged wetland hai jahan paani ki gehraai 1 se 2.5 meter rehti hai. Sheet ritu (winter season) mein yahan ka taapman 9°C se 12°C tak drop hota hai aur paani shant rehta hai, jismein machhliyon aur jaliye vanaspatiyon ka bhandar hota hai. Charo taraf makhana, singhara aur barik ghaas ki green carpeting dikhti hai jo parindon ke feed ke liye ideal habitat banati hai.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Kusheshwar Asthan Bird Sanctuary (1994) / Historic Shiva Pilgrimage
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Ise 1994 mein Wildlife Protection Act ke tehat Bird Sanctuary ghoshit kiya gaya tha. Winter season mein yahan Central Asia aur Siberia se Pelican, Dalmatian Pelican, Pintail aur Siberian Crane jaise durlabh pravasi pakshi aate hain. Iske sath hi yahan sthit aitihasik Baba Kusheshwar Nath Shiva Mandir ke chalte yeh ek bada dharamik sthal bhi hai. Bihar Sarkar is wetland ko Ramsar Site ka darja dilane aur bird-watching infrastructure vikasit karne ke liye kaam kar rahi hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Mithila basin ka saucer-shaped shallow seasonal chaur wetland ecosystem.
Kamla-Balan, Kareh aur Kosi river inter-basin flood waters.
1994 mein notified Pakshi Abhayaranya aur Baba Kusheshwar Nath Shiv Mandir sthal.
BPSC Prelims: 'Kusheshwar Asthan Pakshi Abhayaranya Bihar ke kis zile mein sthit hai?' Answer: Darbhanga.

waterbody_name: Goga Bil Lake / Goga Chhap (गोगाबिल झील)

location.exact_spot: Amdabad block, Ganga aur Mahananda nadiyon ke beech

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Ganga aur Mahananda river meander oxbow cut-off
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Goga Bil jheel ka nirmarn Ganga nadi ke uttar aur Mahananda ke dakshin ke moddaar bahaav ke chhootne (oxbow cut-off) se hua hai. Monsoon ke dino mein Ganga aur Mahananda ke flood channels is jheel mein judte hain, jisse iska aakar lagbhag 217 acre mein phail jata hai. Sukhe mausam mein yeh mukhy nadi se alag hokar ek shant gokhuri jheel ke roop mein zinda rehti hai, jise zameen ke groundwater seepage se fresh water milta rehta hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Oxbow lake depth 2 to 4 meters; Year-round fresh water spread
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Goga Bil ek typical crescent (chandrakar) aakar ki gokhuri jheel hai jiska paani saaf aur meetha hota hai. Yahan ka mausam North-East Bihar ka aadr (humid) climate hai jahan aaspas tea aur jute cultivation ke tracts hain. Jheel ke talhathi mein zameen upjau silty alluvium hai jahan aquatic weeds aur local indigenous fish species (jaise Katla, Mangur) prachur matra mein panapti hain.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Bihar's First Community Reserve (August 2019) / Important Bird Area (IBA)
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: August 2019 mein Goga Bil ko rashtriya star par Bihar ka 'Pehla Community Reserve' (First Community Reserve of Bihar) ghoshit kiya gaya tha. Yeh sthan Important Bird Area (IBA) ke roop mein certified hai jahan lagbhag 90 se zyada kismo ke parinde aate hain, jinme Lesser Whistling Duck aur Asian Openbill Stork pramukh hain. Local graminon ne is jheel ke parindon ko shikar se bachane ke liye khud aage aakar conservation initiative liya hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Crescent-shaped gokhuri jheel (Oxbow lake) jo 217 acre ke fresh-water basin mein faili hai.
Ganga aur Mahananda river system inter-junction.
August 2019 mein designated Bihar ka Pehla Community Reserve (First Community Reserve).
BPSC 65th/66th Prelims: 'Bihar ka pehla Samudayik Sanrakshan Kshetr (Community Reserve) kis jheel ko ghoshit kiya gaya?' Answer: Goga Bil (Katihar).

waterbody_name: Baraila Lake / Salim Ali Jubba Sahni Bird Sanctuary (बरैला झील)

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Gandak flood plain tectonic depression and channel cutoff
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Baraila jheel North Bihar ke Vaishali zile mein Gandak aur Noon nadiyon ke flood plain ke ek natural bhoo-garbhik dhasav (depression) mein banti hai. Monsoon ke dauran charo taraf ka runoff paani is vishal dharatal mein aakar jama ho jata hai, jisse yeh lagbhag 2,000 hectare se zyada kshetr mein phail kar ek daldali jheel ka roop leti hai. Yahan saal-bhar paani thehra rehta hai jo aquatic plants se aachhadit rehta hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Average water depth 1.5 se 3 meters; Dense floating aquatic vegetation
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Baraila wetland shallow water aur daldali keechad se bhari hui hai, jahan phoolon wale kamal (lotus), hydrilla aur water hyacinth ki dense chaadar tairti rehti hai. Yahan ka taapman maidaani ilaqe jaisa hota hai jahan sardi mein kafi thandak aur shant dhoop milti hai. Yeh shallow wetland diving birds aur waders ke liye machhli aur keede pakadne ka paradise hai.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Salim Ali Jubba Sahni Sanctuary (1997) / Migratory Waterfowl Haven
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: 1997 mein is jheel ko swatantrata senani Jubba Sahni aur mahan ornithologist Dr. Salim Ali ke samman mein 'Salim Ali Jubba Sahni Bird Sanctuary' ghoshit kiya gaya tha. Yahan winter season mein 50 se zyada kismo ke pravasi pakshi (jaise Common Teal, Gadwall, Shoveler) aate hain. Local machhuara samuday ke sath milkar state forest department is wetland ko encroachers aur weed overgrowth se bachane ke liye restoration chala raha hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Gandak alluvial flood plain ka vishal low-lying chaur wetland.
Gandak-Noon river catchment area.
1997 mein sthapit Salim Ali Jubba Sahni Pakshi Abhayaranya.
BPSC Prelims: 'Baraila jheel (Salim Ali Jubba Sahni Bird Sanctuary) Bihar ke kis zile mein sthit hai?' Answer: Vaishali.

waterbody_name: Udaipur Lake / Saraiya Man (उदयपुर झील / सरैया मन)

location.exact_spot: Bettiah town ke nikat, Gandak River basin

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Gandak river cut-off oxbow lake (Gokhuri Man)
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Udaipur jheel (jise sthaniya bhasha mein Saraiya Man kaha jata hai) Gandak nadi ke sadiyon purane moddaar pravah ke alag hone (oxbow cut-off) se bani hai. Nadi jab pashchim ki taraf khisak gayi, toh uska purana chhaadan jalashay ek vishal meetha jheel bankar reh gaya. Yeh wetland Gandak ke upri catchment aur Shivalik foothills ke runoff se saal-bhar taro-taza rehti hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Oxbow lake depth 2 to 5 meters; Antiseptic clear fresh water
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Saraiya Man ka aakar lamba aur vishal hai. Is jheel ki sabse hairatangez physical property yeh hai ki iske tat par vishal sankhya mein Jamun (black plum) ke ped lage hain. Jamun ke phal aur patte lagatar paani mein girte rehte hain, jisse iske paani mein natural antiseptic properties paayi jaati hain aur yeh saaf aur swadishth rehta hai. Sub-Himalayan Terai ke kareeb hone se yahan saal-bhar mausam aakarshak aur sheetal rehta hai.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Core of Udaipur Wildlife Sanctuary (1978) / Eco-Tourism Bird Haven
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Yeh jheel 1978 mein sthapit 'Udaipur Wildlife Sanctuary' ka central lifeline hai. Yahan wild boar, barking deer, chital ke sath-sath winter season mein lakho migratory water birds aakar rukte hain. Bettiah Raj ke daur se hi yeh shahi aakarshan ka sthal raha hai. Bihar State Tourism Development Corporation (BSTDC) ne yahan paddle boating, nature walk pathways aur canopy watchtowers banwaye hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Gandak nadi ke chhaadan se bani prachin gokhuri jheel (Man).
Gandak Nadi / Shivalik foothills border zone.
Udaipur Vanyajeev Abhayaranya (1978) ka central water core.
BPSC Prelims: 'Udaipur Vanyajeev Abhayaranya aur Saraiya Man jheel Bihar ke kis zile mein sthit hain?' Answer: Paschim Champaran (West Champaran).

waterbody_name: Nagi Dam & Nakti Dam (नागी डैम व नकटी डैम)

location.exact_spot: Jhajha block, Jhunjhunia pahadiyon ke talhati mein

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Nagi aur Nakti pahadi rivulets par bane masonry irrigation dams
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Nagi Dam aur Nakti Dam ka nirmarn Chota Nagpur pathar ke boundary par sthit Jamui ki dry pahadiyon se aane wale Nagi aur Nakti nalon ko baandhkar (damming) sinchai ke liye kiya gaya tha. In do reservoirs ka jalashay pahadiyon se aane wale runoff paani se bharta hai. Pathari dharatal aur aaspas scrub forests hone ki wajah se inka paani saaf aur shant rehta hai, jo aage chalkar dry season mein ek vishal wetland habitat ban jata hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Reservoir depth up to 8-10 meters; Clear hill runoff water spread
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Yeh do alag-alag reservoirs hain jo kuch hi kilometer ki doori par sthit hain. Inki gehraai dam wall ke paas 8 se 10 meter tak rehti hai aur piche shallow water shoreline banti hai. Jamui ka climate semi-arid plateau margin hai jahan garmiyon mein tezz garmi hoti hai par winter season mein taapman kafi gir jata hai, jisse yeh jheel door-daraaz ke parindon ke liye anukul sharan-sthali ban jati hai.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Designated Ramsar Sites (2024) / Bar-headed Goose Habitat & Kalrav Bird Festival
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Nagi aur Nakti dono ko varsh 2024 mein aadhikarik roop se international **Ramsar Sites** ka status diya gaya hai. Yeh vishva-stariya mahatva rakhti hain kyunki yahan Central Asia se aane wale 'Bar-headed Goose' (jo Mount Everest ke upar udne ke liye jane jate hain) ka global population ka lagbhag 1 se 2 percent aakar rukta hai. Bihar ka pehla state bird festival 'Kalrav' 2021 mein Nagi-Nakti mein hi aayojit hua tha, jisse yeh national bird tourism map par ubhra.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Pahadi runoff par bane twin masonry water reservoirs aur shallow shoreline wetlands.
Jhunjhunia Hills (Jamui) / Nagi aur Nakti rivulets.
Varsh 2024 mein certified Ramsar Sites; 2021 mein Bihar ka pehla rajkiya pakshi mahotsav 'Kalrav' yahin hua.
BPSC 67th/68th Prelims: 'Bihar ka pehla rajya pakshi mahotsav 'Kalrav' kis pakshi abhayaranya mein aayojit kiya gaya tha?' Answer: Nagi-Nakti Dam (Jamui).

waterbody_name: Brahmakund & Rajgir Hot Springs (ब्रह्मकुंड व राजगीर के गर्म जलकुंड)

location.exact_spot: Vaibhargiri aur Vipulagiri Hills ki talhati, Rajgir town

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Tectonic fault lines / Deep underground mineral & sulfur fissures
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Rajgir ke garam jal-kund kisi jwalamukhi se nahi, balki zameen ke bheetari structure se bante hain. Rajgir panch pahadon se ghira hua hai jahan ki quartzite aur schist chattano mein prachin bhoo-garbhik dararein (faults aur fissures) hain. Jab baarish ka paani zameen ke andar bohot gehraai tak chala jata hai, toh zameen ke bheetar ki natural garmi se paani garam ho jata hai. Garm hone par paani halka hokar inhi dararon ke sahare tezz pressure ke sath upar dharatal par ubalte hue jharnon ke roop mein phoot padta hai, jismein gandhak (sulfur) ghula hota hai.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Water Temperature lagbhag 87°C (Brahmakund); Bihar ka sabse garm jal-kund
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Rajgir mein lagbhag 22 se zyada garm kund hain, jinme 'Brahmakund' sabse mukhya aur sabse garm hai, jiska taapman lagbhag 87°C (lagbhag 188°F) tak rehta hai jo lagbhag ubalne ke kareeb hai. Paani mein sulfur aur doosre minerals ghule hone ke karan isme halki gandhak ki mehak aati hai. Saptadhara (saat dharayein), Suryakund, Chandrakund aur Makhdoom Kund iske anya mukhya kund hain. Paani mein ghule minerals ke karan is paani mein snan karne se twacha ke rog (skin diseases) aur jodon ka dard theek hone ki aushadhiye shakti maani jaati hai.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Historic Malmas Mela / Inter-faith Spiritual Thermal Sanctuary
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Brahmakund Hindu, Buddhist, Jain aur Sufi charo dharmo ke liye pavitra hai. Har teen saal par aane wale 'Malmas (Adhikmas) Mela' ke dauran poore desh se lakhon shradhalu yahan aakar Brahmakund ke pavitra garm paani mein snan karte hain. Buddhist granthon ke anusar Buddha yahan snan karte the aur paas hi Tapodarama monastery thi. Sufi sant Makhdoom Yahya Maneri ka kund bhi yahin hai. Bihar Sarkar ne kund parisar ko marble ghats, security pipelines aur modern changing facilities ke sath international spiritual tourism hub ke roop mein vikasit kiya hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Geothermal heated sulfur water spring jiska tapman 87°C tak record hota hai.
Vaibhargiri aur Vipulagiri pahadiyon ki quartzite dararein.
Har teen varsh mein aayojit hone wala vishva-prasiddha Rajgir Malmas Mela.
BPSC Prelims: 'Bihar ka sabse garm jal-kund kaun sa hai aur yeh kahan sthit hai?' Answer: Brahmakund (Rajgir, Nalanda - taapman lagbhag 87°C).

waterbody_name: Sitakund & Munger Hot Springs Group (सीताकुंड व मुंगेर के गर्म जलकुंड)

location.exact_spot: Kharagpur Hills belt, Sitakund (Munger shahar se 6 km door) aur Rishikund

origin_and_geographical_source.water_source_or_formation: Kharagpur quartzite fault zones / Mineral-rich geothermal fissures
origin_and_geographical_source.explanation: Munger ke garm jal-kund Kharagpur ki prachin Dharwar quartzite aur metamorphic pahadiyon ke fault lines se bante hain. Rainwater jab in gehre joints se hota hua zameen ke bheetari tapman se sampark mein aata hai, toh geothermal pressure ke karan garm hokar dharatal par springs ke roop mein bahar nikalta hai. Kharagpur hills range Rajgir ke baad Bihar ka doosra sabse bada geothermal belt hai, jismein Sitakund, Rishikund, Lakshmishwar Kund, Hingania Kund aur Bhimbandh ke garm srot aate hain.

physical_features_and_climate.temperature_or_height: Water Temperature lagbhag 60°C se 65°C; Radioactive trace elements aur sulfur-rich jal
physical_features_and_climate.explanation: Sitakund ka paani lagatar lagbhag 60°C se 65°C taapman par ubalta rehta hai, jismein se lagatar steam aur gas ke bulbule nikalte dikhte hain. Hairatangez baat yeh hai ki is garm kund ke theek paas char thande paani ke kund (Ramkund, Lakshmankund, Shatrughnakund aur Bharata Kund) sthit hain. Paani bilkul transparent hota hai aur isme halki radioactivity aur sulfur hota hai jo digestive aur skin ailments ke liye labhkari maana jata hai.

ecological_and_tourism_importance.core_importance: Mythological Agnipariksha Heritage / Magh Purnima Pilgrimage
ecological_and_tourism_importance.explanation: Pauranik kathaon ke mutabiq Lanka vijay ke baad Sita mata ne apni pavitrata sabit karne ke liye jo Agnipariksha di thi, us agni ki garmi se is kund ka paani sadaiv ke liye garm ho gaya. Har saal Magh Purnima ke avsar par yahan ek mahine lamba vishal mela lagta hai jahan door-door se log aakar puja-archana karte hain. Kharagpur pahadiyon ke jungle mein sthit Rishikund aur Bhimbandh hot springs wildlife sanctuary aur forest tourism ke major components hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Kharagpur quartzite geological fault se nikalne wala 60°C–65°C garm geothermal spring.
Kharagpur Hills (Dharwar formation).
Magh Purnima ka vishal paramprik snan mela.
BPSC Prelims: 'Sitakund aur Rishikund garm jal-srot Bihar ke kis zile mein sthit hain?' Answer: Munger.
